  "sections": {
    "overview": {
      "heading": "What this document is",
      "notes": [
        {
          "lead": "Dual-homed Internet edge",
          "text": "two carriers terminate on an independent router each, running eBGP with default-only acceptance, so no single carrier or router failure isolates the site."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Active/standby firewall pair",
          "text": "all north-south traffic is inspected and failover is stateful over a dedicated 2×10G bundle."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Collapsed core rather than a three-tier campus",
          "text": "two chassis run as one logical switch, and every downstream device dual-homes into it with a port-channel that takes one member from each chassis — so losing a chassis is a member loss, not an outage."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Dual-homed access",
          "text": "three floor access switches, one server access switch and one wireless controller, each on a 2×10G multi-chassis EtherChannel."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Out-of-band management is physically separate",
          "text": "its own switch, its own VLAN, no route to production and no dependency on the production data path."
        },
        {
          "lead": "One open defect is left visible on purpose",
          "text": "rack power does not survive a single-feed loss at the designed load. It is finding 1, not a footnote — a design checklist that never fails anything is not being run."
        }
      ],
      "provenance": [

  "sections": {
    "overview": {
      "heading": "What this document is",
      "notes": [
        {
          "lead": "Dual-homed Internet edge",
          "text": "two carriers terminate on an independent router each, running eBGP with default-only acceptance, so no single carrier or router failure isolates the site."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Active/standby firewall pair",
          "text": "all north-south traffic is inspected and failover is stateful over a dedicated 2×10G bundle."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Collapsed core rather than a three-tier campus",
          "text": "two chassis run as one logical switch, and every downstream device dual-homes into it with a port-channel that takes one member from each chassis — so losing a chassis is a member loss, not an outage."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Dual-homed access & HA wireless controllers",
          "text": "three floor access switches, one server access switch and an SSO HA wireless controller pair, each on a 2×10G multi-chassis EtherChannel."
        },
        {
          "lead": "Out-of-band management is physically separate",
          "text": "its own switch, its own VLAN, no route to production and no dependency on the production data path."
        },
        {
          "lead": "One open defect is left visible on purpose",
          "text": "rack power does not survive a single-feed loss at the designed load. It is finding 1, not a footnote — a design checklist that never fails anything is not being run."
        }
      ],
      "provenance": [
